children: Stock-specific activity is likely to remain in focus on Dalal Street on September 25, following a slew of corporate developments, and earnings.
ESDS Software Solution share price shed 5% despite the company reported a 14% YoY jump in Q1 net profit to ₹29.3 crore from ₹25.7 crore, while revenue rose 7.3% YoY to ₹133.7 crore from ₹124.6 crore.

Wheels India share price gained 3% after the company opened its qualified institutions placement (QIP) on September 24, with the floor price set at ₹2,197.10 per share. The company may offer a discount of up to 5% on the floor price.

FSN E-Commerce Ventures (Nykaa) share price gained 1% after Nykaa and BOLD, L’Oréal's corporate venture capital fund, announced a collaboration to jointly invest in high-growth Indian beauty and personal care brands.
Purple Style Labs share price fell 2% despite the company reported a narrowing of Q1 loss to ₹88.1 crore from ₹100.3 crore, while revenue jumped 13% YoY to ₹119.4 crore from ₹105.7 crore.

JSW Cement share price shed 1% after the company received a show-cause notice proposing a GST demand of ₹229.85 crore, along with applicable interest and a 10% penalty, over alleged short payment due to incorrect classification. Separately, JSW One Platforms has filed a DRHP for an IPO to raise up to ₹3,054 crore.

Investors are expected to remain focused on brokerage calls, block deals, order wins, regulatory developments and other company-specific triggers that could drive stock-level volatility during the session.

title: Buzzing Stocks: ESDS Software slips 5% despite 14% profit jump; JSW Cement falls on ₹230 crore GST notice
